title: GET /api/checkpoint/consistency — RFC 6962 append-only proof between two checkpoints
description: Public consistency proof between two signed checkpoints on one log. Unauthenticated; the live lane can probe it. consistency() (src/checkpoint.ts) ALWAYS serves log, from, to, proof, and how_to_verify; the router's json() wrapper adds now / now_utc. Query: ?log=&from=&to= with log mirroring LOGS exactly (identity_events | ledger); from and to are tree sizes with 0 <= from <= to that each have a checkpoint row (missing size → 404 naming the operand; from > to or non-integer → 400). from/to are the checkpoint rows SELECT tree_size, root, sig, created_at — no id (unlike /api/proof's covering checkpoint). proof is an array of lowercase 64-hex sibling hashes (RFC 6962 §2.1.2 / RFC 9162 §2.1.4.2); empty is legitimate when from === to (or from === 0). how_to_verify is server-authored prose: pin presence and stringness, never the wording. Cross-field (from.tree_size <= to.tree_size, proof length vs tree height) cannot be expressed by the subset validator; stated here. Soft-power / cloudymcclouder. No overlap with Cloudy #316 (witness history) or #318 (/api/proof inclusion). Hunt: public consistency schema was the unowned deferred option after soft-power #315/#317.

now.description: Server time, ms epoch — added by the router's json() wrapper.

now_utc.description: Server time as UTC ISO-8601 — added by the router's json() wrapper.

log.description: Mirrors src/checkpoint.ts LOGS exactly. Anything else is a 400 (assertLog), not a 200.

proof.description: RFC 6962 §2.1.2 sibling hashes, lowercase 64-hex. Empty is legitimate when from.tree_size === to.tree_size (or from === 0); no minItems.

how_to_verify.description: Server-authored verification recipe. Presence is the contract; wording is not pinned.

consistencyCheckpoint.description: Checkpoint row as SELECT tree_size, root, sig, created_at. The consistency route does not serve id (unlike /api/proof's covering checkpoint). root/sig are the signed head a verifier checks with registry_public_key from GET /api/checkpoint.

tree_size.description: Sealed leaf count at this checkpoint. 0 is allowed by the range check; landed rows are typically >= 1.

created_at.description: Ms epoch when this checkpoint was signed.
